sources.title: DT Gracen Halton would give the Broncos another interior pass rusher
sources.description: One prospect the Broncos may have interest in during the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft is Oklahoma defensive tackle Gracen Halton. He is a 6-3, 293-pound defensive lineman who is considered one of the better interior pass rushers in the 2026 NFL Draft. Halton is coming off a productive year for Oklahoma and […]
